In this vignette, we use Gene set variation analysis ( GSVA) to calculate GSVA scores for different genesets used in the paper. 

```{r}

library(GSVA)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(genefu)
data(pam50.robust)
library(clusterProfiler) #for read.gmt function

main_dir = "~/HollandLabShared/breast_landscapes/Sonali_final_data/Objects"
umap_data2 = read.delim("final_metadata_5_21_2026.txt", header=T, stringsAsFactors=F)
gene_exp_file = readRDS("log2_tpm_counts.rds")

# 1. pathways for reactome, KEGG, biocarta , GO , Hallmark
extdata = "~/HollandLabShared/DATASETS_CLEAN_from_Sonali/msigdb"

kegg_db <- read.gmt(file.path(extdata, "c2.cp.kegg.v7.2.symbols.gmt"))
biocarta_db <- read.gmt(file.path(extdata, "c2.cp.biocarta.v7.2.symbols.gmt"))
reactome_db <- read.gmt(file.path(extdata, "c2.cp.reactome.v7.2.symbols.gmt"))
go_bp = read.gmt(file.path(extdata, "c5.go.bp.v7.2.symbols.gmt"))
tft_db = read.gmt(file.path(extdata, "c3.tft.v2023.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"))
hallmark = read.gmt(file.path(extdata, "h.all.v7.2.symbols.gmt"))

kegg_lst= split(kegg_db, kegg_db[,1])
kegg_lst = lapply(kegg_lst, function(x) x[,2])

biocarta_lst= split(biocarta_db, biocarta_db[,1])
biocarta_lst = lapply(biocarta_lst, function(x) x[,2])

reactome_lst= split(reactome_db, reactome_db[,1])
reactome_lst = lapply(reactome_lst, function(x) x[,2])

go_bp= split(go_bp, go_bp[,1])
go_bp = lapply(go_bp, function(x) x[,2])

tft_db= split(tft_db, tft_db[,1])
tft_db = lapply(tft_db, function(x) x[,2])

hallmark= split(hallmark, hallmark[,1])
hallmark = lapply(hallmark, function(x) x[,2])

counts = gene_exp_file

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(counts, kegg_lst, maxDiff=TRUE)
kegg_res <- gsva(gsvapar) 

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(counts, biocarta_lst, maxDiff=TRUE)
biocarta_res <- gsva(gsvapar)

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(counts, reactome_lst, maxDiff=TRUE)
reactome_res <- gsva(gsvapar)

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(counts, go_bp, maxDiff=TRUE)
gobp_res <- gsva(gsvapar)

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(counts, tft_db, maxDiff=TRUE)
tft_res <- gsva(gsvapar)

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(counts, hallmark, maxDiff=TRUE)
hallmark_res <- gsva(gsvapar)

score = rbind(tft_res, gobp_res, hallmark_res, reactome_res, biocarta_res, kegg_res)
saveRDS(score , file = "pathways.rds")


# 2. PAM 50 subtyping 
# Note : need the entrz id for the genes
entrez = mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = rownames(gene_exp_file),
                column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first" )
entrez <- data.frame( gene_symbol = names(entrez), entrez_id = as.character(entrez),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(entrez) = c("probe", "EntrezGene.ID")
rownames(entrez) = entrez$probe

pam50_result <- molecular.subtyping(sbt.model = "pam50", data= t(gene_exp_file),
                                    annot=as.matrix(entrez), do.mapping=TRUE)
saveRDS(pam50_result, "pam50_result_all_samples.rds")


# 3. read in gene lists ( CAF, TAM, peripheral neuron, immune gene lists, resistance scores) 
goi <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx("Final_supplemental_Tables.xlsx", sheet = 3))
gset <- apply(goi, 2, function(x){
  rm = which(x=="")
  if(length(rm)!=0){
    x[-rm]
  }
})

gsvapar <- gsvaParam(gene_exp_file,gset, maxDiff=TRUE)
my_res <- gsva(gsvapar)
my_res = t(my_res)

saveRDS(res, "GSVA_scores.rds")
```
